patch_description: Per the recommendation: increase k_paths to 16 candidates per destination, drop the load-based score re-sorting, and rank candidates purely by path cost. shortest_simple_paths already yields paths in ascending cost order, so we avoid re-sorting and use a cost-based early-exit (stop generating once a candidate exceeds 3x the best cost) to keep runtime bounded. All num_partitions are assigned to the single cheapest path, since spreading partitions over costlier paths only raises total transfer cost. Falls back to Dijkstra if k-shortest-path enumeration fails.
